proposals.title: Daily Character Quest & Credits
proposals.oneLiner: Earn bonus chat credits daily by completing a quick interactive mini-game with Luzia.

newMechanic.name: Daily Character Quest
newMechanic.description: A daily engagement task where users play a 15-second mini-game with Luzia to earn bonus chat credits.
newMechanic.whyNeeded: Luzia currently lacks a daily retention loop and free ad-monetization path for non-paying users on the home tab.

proposals.trigger: User taps the daily quest banner on the Chats Home hub upon returning to the app.
proposals.eligibility: Non-paying users who have completed their first session and have remaining daily quota capacity.

offer.title: Play Daily Quest Now
offer.body: Play a quick 15-second mini-game with Luzia to earn 10 bonus chat credits.

proposals.cannibalizationGuard: Gated to non-paying users with strict daily caps, rewarding soft usage quota rather than permanent subscription features or premium reasoning models.

kpis.primary: Rewarded ARPDAU and D7/D30 user retention.
guardrails: Paid conversion non-inferiority (-3% max relative drop)
Daily message volume per active user
App store sentiment and crash rates
kpis.holdout: User-level 10% randomized holdout running for 28 days.

risks: Low risk of minor fatigue if daily caps are exceeded
Ensure game partner tone remains fully SFW and aligned with Luzia's brand
